title: Two-Timescale Design for Movable Antenna-Enabled Multiuser MIMO Systems
release_scope: independent reduced-size MRT AO/SCA core-algorithm reproduction; not all published figures

equations.scope: Rician model, i.i.d. NLoS core model; fixed numerical fixture for parity
instantaneous SINR, MRT channel-proportional allocation, actual total-power normalization
MRT closed-form approximation, analytic gradient, antenna-wise SCA quadratic surrogate and convexified distance constraints
ZF statistical bound and instantaneous equal-user-power ZF evaluation only; no ZF position optimizer

disclosures: Dimensionless wavelength-normalized 6-antenna/3-user scene differs from published figure scenarios.
The 2D convex quadratic surrogate subproblem is solved by exact projection onto a clipped convex polygon rather than CVX.

The Hessian curvature uses the spectral eigenvalue formula in Eq29a; the displayed closed-form Eq29b has a negative sign before the offdiagonal-square term, inconsistent with the eigenvalue identity, and is not used.
Three explicit deterministic NLoS arrays are test fixtures, not independent random Gaussian realizations or estimates of the ergodic expectation.
No spatially correlated extension, energy model, ZF position AO/MM, or 20-figure sweep is implemented.
